title.value: Predicting the Mathematics Literacy of Resilient Students from High-performing Economies: A Machine Learning Approach
title.justification: The title clearly outlines the subject and methodology of the research paper: predicting mathematics literacy using a machine learning approach.
title.quote: Predicting the Mathematics Literacy of Resilient Students from High-performing Economies: A Machine Learning Approach

analysis.description: This study applies machine learning techniques, specifically Lasso Regression (LR) and Random Forest (RF), to predict the mathematics literacy of resilient students from high-performing economies in PISA 2022. The paper explores cultural differences in the performance of these algorithms, with a particular focus on how predictors like mathematics self-efficacy and anxiety contribute differently across cultures.

type.justification: The research uses empirical data from the PISA 2022 dataset to apply machine learning techniques for predicting outcomes.
type.quote: The study applied two machine learning algorithms, Lasso Regression (LR) and Random Forest (RF), to predict the mathematics literacy of resilient students from high-performing economies across cultures in PISA 2022.

name.justification: The research utilizes machine learning algorithms to analyze educational data drawn from the PISA survey, which is a key characteristic of Educational Data Mining.
name.quote: Specifically, this study intends to predict resilient students’ mathematics literacy based on features extracted from student mandatory questionnaires and well-being questionnaires in PISA 2022 through machine learning (ML) techniques.

name.justification: The study applies machine learning algorithms, particularly Lasso Regression and Random Forest, to educational data.
name.quote: This study applied two machine learning algorithms, Lasso Regression (LR) and Random Forest (RF), to predict the mathematics literacy of resilient students from high-performing economies.

name.justification: The focus is on predicting the mathematics literacy of students, which is directly related to the field of mathematics education.
name.quote: This study applied two machine learning algorithms, Lasso Regression (LR) and Random Forest (RF), to predict the mathematics literacy of resilient students from high-performing economies.

name.justification: Lasso Regression is one of the two machine learning models utilized in the study to predict mathematics literacy.
name.quote: This study applied two machine learning algorithms, Lasso Regression (LR) and Random Forest (RF), to predict the mathematics literacy of resilient students.

is_contributed.justification: Lasso Regression is a well-established machine learning algorithm and not an original contribution of this paper.
is_contributed.quote: This study applied two machine learning algorithms, Lasso Regression (LR) and Random Forest (RF)...

is_executed.justification: The paper discusses the implementation of Lasso Regression in the prediction process, indicating execution.
is_executed.quote: Both the RF and LR algorithms were developed using the caret package (Kuhn, 2008) in R (R Core Team, 2024)...

is_compared.justification: The performance of Lasso Regression is compared with Random Forest across different metrics (RMSE, R², MAE) and cultural contexts.
is_compared.quote: A Kruskal-Wallis test was employed on the scores (i.e., RMSE, R², and MAE) of the four ML algorithms (i.e., RF for Eastern cultures, RF for Western cultures, LR for Eastern cultures, and LR for Western cultures).
